picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed a custom bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a striking proof that generative AI can produce functional biological therapeutics, not just predictions.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia's CEO exit amid a national-security investigation threatens to destabilize the company at the center of the global AI compute supply chain, with ripple effects for every lab and university depending on its hardware.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: An independent machine-learning technique confirmed the iconic Event Horizon Telescope image of the M87 black hole in Nature, showing AI can rigorously validate — not just generate — landmark scientific findings.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA researchers overturned assumptions about how much training data AI needs for materials-science prediction, a finding that could sharply cut the cost of AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's ZEBRA-Prop offers a lightweight, language-model-based approach to predicting material properties, broadening access to AI-accelerated materials research beyond groups with heavy compute budgets.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学

picks.editorial_note: A $19 million state grant lets Texas Tech build a next-generation computing cluster fusing AI with high-fidelity simulation, a concrete investment in regional semiconductor R&D infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: MIT's new quantization method tackles the KV-cache memory bottleneck in large language models, a NeurIPS-bound advance that could meaningfully cut the cost of running LLMs at scale.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization

picks.editorial_note: Indiana University's new Applied Research Center formalizes university-wide ties with government and industry on AI-related national security priorities, signaling deeper academia-government integration.
picks.title: Indiana University expands national security research partnerships through Applied Research Center

picks.editorial_note: A $1 million NSF award backs a Syracuse-Notre Dame-UT San Antonio effort to build implantable medical devices that adapt to individual patients, pairing AI with direct clinical application.
picks.title: New Research Explores Medical Devices That Adapt to Each Patient

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's role in the $4.8 million AERONET project applies AI-coordinated networking to aviation safety communications, a tangible infrastructure payoff from federally funded AI research.
picks.title: UCR joins $4.8 million aviation safety endeavor
